apps.localizedDescription:
Pageturner:

An e-reader and audiobook player for iOS, linked to BookMaster. Everything runs on the device — books, covers, positions and the library live in the app.

The iOS app:

A native SwiftUI app (iOS 17+) built on the Readium toolkit. It lives in ios/.
